agency_name_conflict.question: Two canon records head the same intelligence agency under different names: char_sarina_vael is "Director of the Galactic Security Bureau (GSB)" and char_callan_deyrus is "Head of Union Intelligence Bureau (UIB)". Canon rules GSB a SUPERSEDED draft name for the UIB.
agency_name_conflict.how_it_survived: char_sarina_vael was promoted on 2026-07-21 with a conflict scan recording "zero name/office collisions". The GSB->UIB superseded-draft ruling is dated 2026-07-20 — one day earlier. The scan did not consult it, which is why her own notes read "No GSB org record exists yet": there is no GSB record because GSB is not a canonical agency.
possible_readings: Sequence: she is an earlier-era director under the earlier agency name, and Deyrus is the current head — exactly the shape of the Durn -> Saros case, where "Director of the Galactic Marshals" was retitled "Chief Marshal" and the two holders were sequential.
Duplication: two salvage generations produced two heads of one agency, and one record should be superseded.
Distinct bodies: GSB and UIB were genuinely different organs and the superseded-draft note is too broad.
agency_name_conflict.why_not_decided: The Durn/Saros parallel is suggestive, not evidence. That case was settled by an explicit owner retcon ruling naming both holders and the retitling; nothing comparable exists here. Choosing sequence would invent a tenure, and choosing duplication would delete a salvaged character.
